senses.gloss:
mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं)
Worthless, undeserving of honour or praise.
E.
अ neg. श्लाघ्य to be praised.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undeserving of honour or praise, base, mean, worthless.
E.
अ neg. श्लाघनीय to be praised.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unlucky, unpropitious.
E.
as अश्रीक, the र being changed to ल.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Coarse, vulgar.
2 Abusive, blackguard.
n. (-लं)
1 Rustic language.
2 Untruth.
3 Low abuse.
E.
अ neg. श्लील elegant.

f. (-षा)
1 The ninth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, containing five stars.
2 Disunion, disjunction.
E.
अ neg. and श्लष union.

m. (-षः)
1 Embracing, an embrace.
2 Site of any act.
3 Intimate connexion.
E.
आङ्, श्लिष to fold, घञ् aff.

m. (-वः)
A name of KETU or the dragon's head: see केतु.
E.
अश्लेषा the asterism, and भव born, born under the sign Aśleṣā; or अश्लेषा disjunction, and भव produced; as KETU was formed of the lower extremities which had been sundered by VIṢṆU from RĀHU.

m. (-भूः)
A name of KETU.
E.
as the preceding, भू to be born, with क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Embraced.
2 Embracing, who or what embraces.
3 Connected, interwoven, blended.
4 Attaching to, joining, who or what adheres to.
5 Invested, spread.
6 Connected as a consequence, deduced, concluded.
E.
आङ् before श्लिष to fold, क्त aff.
